math_and_layout.kv_b_output_per_head: 192 key-noPE + 256 value = 448; concatenate the already rotated shared64 key across8 heads

math_and_layout.redundancy: Projected noPE K and V are functions of normalized latent and fixed kv_b weights; repeated rotary key channels are functions of the separately retained rotated key. This is functional memoization, not proof that removing it preserves current execution rounding or latency.

single_conditional_mechanism.name: Drop persistent projected V only; retain projected K and latent/rotary; regenerate V for selected logical positions using existing expand_cached
single_conditional_mechanism.why_not_free: Existing expand_cached emits both K and V, and kv_b is private. Reusing this API discards extra recomputed K; a value-only projection would require another consumer/API/source modification. This read-only card implements neither.

projection_work.prefill_union: For count512, union of selections across queries may cover the whole32768 prefix; topk2048 is per query and is not a bound on union U.

single_conditional_mechanism.traffic: Removing V saves4096B per arriving token/layer of persistent writes, but adds latent gathers, quantization, kv_b weight/output traffic and selected temporary writes each query. These are logical source bytes, not measured HBM traffic.
single_conditional_mechanism.numerical_unknown: Recomputing at U rather than original arriving M1/512 can change GEMM/kernel shape and BF16 rounding. Same nominal FP8/BF16 precision and real-arithmetic dependence are insufficient to claim current finite-precision equivalence, task quality or exact tokens. No new numeric validation performed.
single_conditional_mechanism.lifecycle_work_required: DefaultOFF guarded nullableV allocation plus selected-V assembly/read replacement, current caller getters/census contracts, all owner/row/past rejection, poison/reset/destroy behavior. No shared source edits made.

Adding logical5GiB saving is only a conditional ledger; it does not prove allocator release, W4 temporary peak, checkpoint loading or original8GiB loaded-service admission. single_conditional_mechanism.next_option_only_if_separately_chosen: A source-first fixed-input current projection/attention consumer could compare same selected positions and current original output against regenerated V, measure complete phase including gathers/quant/projection/scratch and error summaries, before considering any capacity probe. This is not a GPU claim or approval to load Model.

final_boundary: No one-line safe deletion reaches4GiB. A5GiB logical V-cache tradeoff exists, but current code intentionally memoizes that work and historical measurements warn of substantial regression. No implementation/GPU/Model route is selected by this analysis; original8GiB admission and all395 conclusions remain unchanged.
